∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.Public) {Ω : Type}
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point q.d) (η : ℕ → Ω) (n c : ℕ)
  (s : outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.State q.d),
  s.count = c →
    s.hist = q.tree.realize q.gamma q.x0 g η c →
      OracleTemplate.StochasticGradient.advance
          (fun k s =>
            (outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.birch q).update 1 s
              (g ((outputs.Algorithms.BirchSgd.birch q).query 1 s).2 (η k)))
          n c s =
        { count := c + n, hist := q.tree.realize q.gamma q.x0 g η (c + n), chosen := s.chosen }
